messages:
norm: Noticed inconsistency in the /stream/create API docs. The top-level examples use SSE with event: 'message' but the JS SDK snippet shows a WebSocket listener expecting 'data' events. We should pick one canonical streaming pattern and show both server and client shapes.

devon: Runtime supports both SSE and WS, but the JSON envelope keys differ: SSE uses `{event: 'message', data: {...}}` while WS sends raw JSON payloads. Docs currently mix them which confuses customers.

marie: Proposal: update the API ref to have two small subsections: "SSE (recommended for simple clients)" and "WebSocket (low-latency / bi-directional)". Each subsection should include minimal curl/ts/python patterns and clarify the response envelope.

norm: Also found schema mismatch: OpenAPI response schema lists top-level field `message_text` whereas runtime actually returns `content` inside `payload`. Need OpenAPI fix + migration note.

sam: Devex note: if we change schema we must avoid breaking generated snippets. Recommend documenting the runtime truth and annotate OpenAPI with `x-deprecated` for `message_text` and add `content` as the canonical field. That keeps client generators stable while we roll SDK updates.

devex-bot: devex-bot: created preview PR 91011 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/91011. Auto-preview at https://deploy-preview-91011--docs.redwood.ai. Includes SSE/WS sections and schema note.

marie: I've added sample handlers: SSE curl (`curl -N ...`) and Node fetch examples, plus a small ws client using `WebSocket` showing onmessage parsing. Also added the migration snippet showing how to map old `message_text` -> `payload.content`.

devon: Left a nit: in the SSE example please show how to parse comment lines and `event: done` closing message. Also add a small test in the docs harness that asserts the preview SSE payload contains `payload.content`.

norm: Good call. I added the test and updated the SSE example to show `event: done` case. Also added a short line: "If you use auto-generated clients, prefer the SDK streaming helpers; see Devex notes."

devex-bot: docs preview tests passed. PR ready for review.

sam: LGTM from product side. Small ask: add a sentence in the migration guide about older integrations that relied on `message_text` trimming; some customers expect trimmed strings.

marie: Added that line and a one-liner Python snippet to safely read both shapes: `content = msg.get('payload', {}).get('content') or msg.get('message_text')`.

norm: Merged. Will follow up with SDK owners to align streaming helpers and publish a short migration changelog entry. Thanks everyone :rocket:
